title: Qwen3.8 2.4T A95B - API Pricing & Benchmarks | OpenRouter
author: qwen
description: Qwen3.8 2.4T A95B is an open-weight sparse mixture-of-experts model from Qwen and the open-weight variant of [Qwen3.8 Max](/qwen/qwen3.8-max), with 95 billion active parameters out of 2.4 trillion total. $2 per million input tokens, $6 per million output tokens. 1,048,576 token context window, maximum output of 131,072 tokens. Higher uptime with 7 providers. Includes independent benchmarks from Artificial Analysis.
